_comment: Frozen shape of the `mcp_servers` list the app forwards inside the sealed
task frame. Asserted from both sides: app/test/services/mcp/mcp_store_test.dart
builds it from a live McpStore, agent/tests/test_mcp_client.py parses it.
The contract is additive — a receiver ignores fields it does not know — so
entries may gain fields, but no field here may be renamed or removed.
The four entries are the four kinds a connector can be.
